definitions.explanation: Water that has been contaminated, by chemicals, sewage or radioactive material. Since 2011 the word most often refers to the radioactive water produced at the damaged Fukushima Daiichi nuclear plant.

examples.japanese: {汚染水|おせんすい}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{海|うみ}→海：00556_umi⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{流|なが}れ{出|で}た。
examples.english: Contaminated water flowed into the sea.

examples.japanese: ⟦{原発|げんぱつ}→原発：11943_genpatsu⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{汚染水|おせんすい}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{処理|しょり}する→処理する：25531_shorisuru⟧。
examples.english: To treat the contaminated water from the nuclear plant.

examples.japanese: ⟦{工場|こうじょう}→工場：01082_koujou⟧⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧⟦{出|で}た→出る：00513_deru⟧{汚染水|おせんすい}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧せい⟦で→で：00502_de⟧、⟦{川|かわ}→川：02186_kawa⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{魚|さかな}→魚：00499_sakana⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{大量|たいりょう}→大量：03112_tairyou⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{死|し}んだ→死ぬ：00669_shinu⟧。
examples.english: Large numbers of fish in the river died because of polluted water from the factory.

notes:
WATCH OUT:
In news about the Fukushima plant, water that has been through the purification system is called ⟦{処理水|しょりすい}→処理水：33032_shorisui⟧ (treated water); {汚染水|おせんすい} is the untreated water. The choice of word is politically sensitive.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {汚染水|おせんすい}⟦{対策|たいさく}→対策：02511_taisaku⟧: measures against contaminated water
- {汚染水|おせんすい}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{漏|も}れる→漏れる：02435_moreru⟧: contaminated water leaks
- {汚染水|おせんすい}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{処理|しょり}する→処理する：25531_shorisuru⟧: to treat contaminated water

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{汚水|おすい}→汚水：09654_osui⟧: dirty water, sewage — everyday waste water
